tools.name: get_call_price
tools.description: Helps the person call a phone number anywhere in the world with Suparelay: returns the price per minute and a Call link that opens the Suparelay browser dialer with the number ready. Use it when the person wants to call a phone number or asks what a call to it costs. Pass the number in E.164 format

tools.name: get_country_call_prices
tools.description: Helps the person call a country with Suparelay: returns the landline and mobile prices per minute and a Call link that opens the Suparelay browser dialer. Use it when the person wants to call a country or asks what calls to it cost, without a phone number. Pass the two-letter ISO country code, such
